"""Check exact growth-source CI, review state, preview and merge identity."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import growth_support_common as support

c = support.c
HEAD = 'bdb6ec334e8a790734f9b1964ddaae7d6254d3df'
BASE = '63594f41fb2bbc100bac00d26dca8b1a3dc1b781'
RUNTIME = '61a813b71d871e0e7213dcc3740f77c900f50eba'
PR, BASELINE_PR = 1539, 1538
REPO = 'depsilon/shardloom'
GH = '/opt/homebrew/bin/gh'
PREVIEW = 'https://9db55e22-shardloom.djheinrich.workers.dev'
REPORT = 'docs/benchmarks/native-input-growth-2026-10-09.md'
INDEX = 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-input-growth-2026-10-09.json'


def run(*command):
    return subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=c.ROOT, text=True, timeout=60).strip()


def gh_json(*arguments):
    return json.loads(run(GH, *arguments))


def pr(number):
    return gh_json('pr', 'view', str(number), '--repo', REPO, '--json',
        'number,url,state,isDraft,headRefOid,baseRefOid,mergeCommit,mergedAt,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--stage', choices=('premerge', 'postmerge'), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert args.attempt > 0
    prefix = f'growth-hosted-{args.stage}-{args.attempt}'
    assert not (c.OUT / (prefix + '.json')).exists()
    observed, baseline = pr(PR), pr(BASELINE_PR)
    query = f'''query {{ repository(owner: "depsilon", name: "shardloom") {{
      pullRequest(number: {PR}) {{
        reviewThreads(first: 100) {{ nodes {{ id isResolved isOutdated path originalLine
          comments(first: 100) {{ nodes {{ body url author {{ login }} originalCommit {{ oid }} path originalLine }}
            pageInfo {{ hasNextPage }} }} }} pageInfo {{ hasNextPage }} }}
        reviews(last: 100) {{ nodes {{ id state body submittedAt commit {{ oid }} author {{ login }} }}
          pageInfo {{ hasPreviousPage }} }}
        comments(last: 100) {{ nodes {{ id body url author {{ login }} }}
          pageInfo {{ hasPreviousPage }} }}
      }}
    }} }}'''
    reviews = gh_json('api', 'graphql', '-f', 'query=' + query)
    runs = gh_json('api', f'repos/{REPO}/actions/runs?event=pull_request&head_sha={HEAD}&per_page=100')
    check_runs = gh_json('api', f'repos/{REPO}/commits/{HEAD}/check-runs?per_page=100')
    snapshot = {'pr': observed, 'baseline_pr': baseline, 'reviews': reviews,
        'workflow_runs': runs, 'head_check_runs': check_runs,
        'observed_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    c.write(c.OUT / (prefix + '-snapshot.json'), snapshot)
    assert not c.git('status', '--porcelain'), 'requires the clean accepted tree'
    assert observed['number'] == PR and observed['headRefOid'] == HEAD and not observed['isDraft']
    assert observed['reviewDecision'] != 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
    assert baseline['state'] == 'MERGED' and baseline['mergeCommit']['oid'] == BASE
    expected = set(c.read(Path('<home>/LocalData/shardloom/release-0.5.1-20261009')
        / 'release-051-hosted-postmerge-1.json')['hosted_check_names'])
    assert len(expected) == 39 and {row['name'] for row in baseline['statusCheckRollup']} == expected
    for workflow in ('.github/workflows/ci.yml', '.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml'):
        assert c.git('show', BASE + ':' + workflow) == c.git('show', HEAD + ':' + workflow)
    checks = observed['statusCheckRollup']
    assert len(checks) == len(expected) and {row['name'] for row in checks} == expected
    assert all(row['status'] == 'COMPLETED' and row['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS'
        for row in checks), [(row['name'], row['status'], row['conclusion'])
                            for row in checks if row['conclusion'] != 'SUCCESS']
    assert runs['total_count'] == len(runs['workflow_runs']) == 2
    assert {row['name'] for row in runs['workflow_runs']} == {'CI', 'CodeQL Analysis'}
    assert all(row['head_sha'] == HEAD and row['status'] == 'completed'
        and row['conclusion'] == 'success' for row in runs['workflow_runs'])
    assert check_runs['total_count'] == len(check_runs['check_runs'])
    deployment, = [row for row in check_runs['check_runs'] if row['name'] == 'Workers Builds: shardloom']
    codeql, = [row for row in check_runs['check_runs'] if row['name'] == 'CodeQL']
    for row in (deployment, codeql):
        assert row['head_sha'] == HEAD and row['status'] == 'completed' and row['conclusion'] == 'success'
    assert [line.strip() for line in deployment['output']['summary'].splitlines()
        if line.strip().startswith('Preview URL:')] == ['Preview URL: ' + PREVIEW]
    assert 'errors' not in reviews
    review = reviews['data']['repository']['pullRequest']
    assert not review['reviewThreads']['pageInfo']['hasNextPage']
    assert not review['reviews']['pageInfo']['hasPreviousPage']
    assert not review['comments']['pageInfo']['hasPreviousPage']
    assert review['reviewThreads']['nodes'] == [] and review['reviews']['nodes'] == []
    comments = review['comments']['nodes']
    quota = [row for row in comments if row['author']['login'] == 'chatgpt-codex-connector']
    assert len(quota) == 1 and quota[0]['url'] == f'https://github.com/{REPO}/pull/{PR}#issuecomment-6093806491'
    assert quota[0]['body'].startswith('You have reached your Codex usage limits for code reviews.')
    cloudflare = [row for row in comments if row['author']['login'] == 'cloudflare-workers-and-pages']
    assert len(cloudflare) <= 1 and len(comments) == len(quota) + len(cloudflare)
    for row in cloudflare:
        assert 'Deployment successful!' in row['body'] and PREVIEW in row['body'] and HEAD[:8] in row['body']
    source, build, provenance = support.checked_runtime()
    assert source['head'] == RUNTIME and len(source['source_hashes']) == 1020
    primary_path = c.OUT / 'growth-primary-source-review-1.json'
    primary = c.read(primary_path)
    assert primary['status'] == 'completed_no_blocking_findings' and primary['reviewer'] == 'primary_agent'
    assert primary['head_commit'] == HEAD and primary['base_commit'] == BASE
    assert primary['runtime_provenance'] == provenance
    assert not primary['independent_review_claimed'] and not primary['automated_hosted_review_claimed']
    assert all(c.sha(c.ROOT / name) == digest for name, digest in primary['reviewed_source_hashes'].items())
    index = c.read(c.ROOT / INDEX)
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / INDEX) == c.read(c.OUT / 'growth-pre-pr-1.json')['evidence_index_sha256']
    assert index['runtime_commit'] == RUNTIME and index['source_identity_sha256'] == source['source_identity_sha256']
    assert index['documentation_updates_complete'] and not index['hosted_acceptance_complete']
    for file_key, sha_key in (('portable_inspection', 'portable_inspection_sha256'),
                             ('documentation_acceptance', 'documentation_acceptance_sha256')):
        assert c.sha(c.ROOT / index[file_key]) == index[sha_key]
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / index['acceptance']['packet']) == index['acceptance']['packet_sha256']
    docs = c.read(c.ROOT / index['documentation_acceptance'])
    assert docs['status'] == 'passed_local_documentation_acceptance'
    assert docs['runtime_provenance'] == provenance
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / docs['archive']['path']) == docs['archive']['sha256']
    assert docs['archive']['all_members_reopened_and_hash_checked']
    for name, identity in docs['source_files'].items():
        assert (c.ROOT / name).stat().st_size == identity['bytes'] and c.sha(c.ROOT / name) == identity['sha256'], name
    preview_path = c.OUT / 'growth-hosted-preview-1.json'
    preview = c.read(preview_path)
    assert preview['status'] == 'passed_hosted_search_and_guides' and preview['head'] == HEAD
    assert preview['origin'] == PREVIEW and preview['tabClosed'] and preview['viewportReset']
    assert preview['search']['query'] == 'cumulative' and preview['search']['resultCount'] == 1
    assert '1 result for cumulative' in preview['search']['snapshot']
    assert preview['search']['landedUrl'] == PREVIEW + '/field-guide/python-surface/#consume-results-in-batches'
    assert not preview['console']
    assert preview['desktop']['main'] == preview['mobile']['main']
    for field in ('desktop', 'mobile', 'resources', 'limitations'):
        assert preview[field]['body'] <= preview[field]['viewport']
    assert 'without fixed total field or batch counts' in preview['desktop']['main']
    assert 'published 0.5.1 artifacts retain their release-time limits' in preview['limitations']['main']
    assert 'Repeated batch-source use, multiple batch producers and streamed compatibility writes also remain denied.' in preview['limitations']['main']
    assert preview['desktop']['growthLinks'] == [
        {'text': 'input growth contract', 'href': f'https://github.com/{REPO}/blob/main/docs/architecture/native-input-growth-2026-10-09.md'},
        {'text': 'complete growth acceptance', 'href': f'https://github.com/{REPO}/blob/main/{REPORT}'}]
    images = {name: c.sha(c.OUT / name) for name in preview['screenshots']}
    assert len(images) == 4
    if args.stage == 'premerge':
        assert observed['state'] == 'OPEN' and observed['mergeStateStatus'] == 'CLEAN'
        assert observed['baseRefOid'] == BASE and c.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == HEAD
        assert c.git('ls-remote', '--heads', 'origin', 'main').split()[0] == BASE
        merge = None
    else:
        assert observed['state'] == 'MERGED' and observed['mergedAt']
        merge = observed['mergeCommit']['oid']
        assert c.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == merge
        assert c.git('rev-list', '--parents', '-n', '1', merge).split() == [merge, BASE, HEAD]
        assert c.git('rev-parse', merge + '^{tree}') == c.git('rev-parse', HEAD + '^{tree}')
        assert c.git('ls-remote', '--heads', 'origin', 'main').split()[0] == merge
    record = {
        'status': 'passed_' + args.stage, 'pr': PR, 'head': HEAD, 'base': BASE, 'merge_commit': merge,
        'successful_hosted_checks': len(checks), 'hosted_check_names': sorted(expected),
        'runtime_provenance': provenance, 'runtime_commit': RUNTIME,
        'source_identity_sha256': source['source_identity_sha256'], 'runtime_binary_sha256': build['binary_sha256'],
        'acceptance_packet_sha256': index['acceptance']['packet_sha256'],
        'documentation_archive_sha256': docs['archive']['sha256'],
        'primary_source_review_sha256': c.sha(primary_path),
        'hosted_automated_review': 'unavailable_account_review_quota',
        'review_state': 'no_review_threads_or_submitted_reviews',
        'independent_review_claimed': False, 'submitted_approval_inferred': False,
        'hosted_preview_browser_sha256': c.sha(preview_path), 'preview_image_hashes': images,
        'workers_preview_check_run': deployment, 'codeql_check_run': codeql,
        'snapshot_sha256': c.sha(c.OUT / (prefix + '-snapshot.json')),
        'evidence_index_sha256': c.sha(c.ROOT / INDEX),
        'version_fixed': '0.5.1', 'package_publication_attempted': False,
        'broader_roadmap_complete': False, 'driver_sha256': c.sha(__file__),
    }
    c.write(c.OUT / (prefix + '.json'), record)
    print(json.dumps({key: record[key] for key in ('status', 'head', 'merge_commit',
        'successful_hosted_checks', 'hosted_automated_review')}), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':

    actual = c.source_hashes()
    assert snapshot['source_hashes'] == build['source_hashes']
    assert len(actual) == 1020
    assert build['source_identity_sha256'] == snapshot['source_identity_sha256']
    assert sha(build['binary']) == build['binary_sha256']
    final_path = OUT / 'growth-final-acceptance-1.json'
    final = read(final_path)
    assert final['status'] == 'passed_local_engine'
    assert final['source_identity_sha256'] == snapshot['source_identity_sha256']
    assert final['binary_sha256'] == build['binary_sha256'] and final['source_assets'] == len(actual)
    inputs_path = OUT / 'growth-evidence-inputs-1.json'
    assert final['acceptance_inputs_sha256'] == sha(inputs_path)
    assert final['all_current_stages_executed_freshly']
    assert actual == snapshot['source_hashes']
    inspection = read(OUT / 'growth-packet-verified-1.json')
    assert inspection['status'] == 'passed_independent_stream_inspection'
    assert inspection['final_acceptance_sha256'] == sha(final_path)
    assert inspection['packet_sha256'] == final['packet_sha256']
    annotation = {'accepted_runtime_commit': snapshot['head'],
        'accepted_source_identity_sha256': snapshot['source_identity_sha256'],
        'assets_byte_identical': len(actual), 'asset_count_unchanged': len(actual),
        'runtime_or_harness_changed': False,
        'binary_sha256': build['binary_sha256']}
    return snapshot, build, annotation


def portable(value):
    text = json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    for original, replacement in ((str(ROOT), '<repo>'), (str(OUT), '<growth-uat>'), (str(ROOT.home()), '<home>')):
        text = text.replace(original, replacement)
    return text + '\n'

"""Observe the fixed input-growth PR until every expected hosted check succeeds."""
import argparse
import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time

OUT = Path('<growth-uat>')
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--pr', type=int, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--head', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--timeout', type=int, default=2400)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.pr > 0 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', args.head) and args.timeout > 0
assert args.output.parent.resolve() == OUT and not args.output.exists()
expected = set(json.loads((Path('<home>/LocalData/shardloom/release-0.5.1-20261009') / 'release-051-hosted-postmerge-1.json').read_bytes())['hosted_check_names'])
assert len(expected) == 39
record = {'status': 'running', 'pr': args.pr, 'head': args.head,
          'expected_check_names': sorted(expected), 'observations': [], 'network_errors': []}
started = time.monotonic()
last_signature = None
try:
    while time.monotonic() - started < args.timeout:
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(['/opt/homebrew/bin/gh', 'pr', 'view', str(args.pr),
                '--repo', 'depsilon/shardloom', '--json',
                'number,url,state,headRefOid,baseRefOid,isDraft,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup'],
                text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=45)
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip())
            snapshot = json.loads(result.stdout)
        except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
            record['network_errors'].append({'observed_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                                             'error': f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}'})
            print(json.dumps({'status': 'observation_unavailable', 'error_type': type(error).__name__}), flush=True)
            time.sleep(30)
            continue
        assert snapshot['number'] == args.pr and snapshot['headRefOid'] == args.head
        assert snapshot['state'] == 'OPEN' and not snapshot['isDraft']
        checks = snapshot['statusCheckRollup']
        names = {row['name'] for row in checks}
        assert names <= expected and len(names) == len(checks), names - expected
        signature = sorted((row['name'], row['status'], row['conclusion']) for row in checks)
        if signature != last_signature:
            summary = {'observed_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                       'total': len(checks), 'success': sum(row['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS' for row in checks),
                       'remaining': [{'name': row['name'], 'status': row['status'], 'conclusion': row['conclusion']}
                                     for row in checks if row['conclusion'] != 'SUCCESS']}
            record['observations'].append(summary)
            print(json.dumps(summary), flush=True)
            last_signature = signature
        record['latest_snapshot'] = snapshot
        failures = [row for row in checks if row['status'] == 'COMPLETED' and
                    row['conclusion'] not in ('SUCCESS', 'NEUTRAL')]
        assert not failures, [(row['name'], row['conclusion']) for row in failures]
        assert snapshot['reviewDecision'] != 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
        if names == expected and all(row['status'] == 'COMPLETED' and row['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS' for row in checks):
            record['status'] = 'passed'
            break
        time.sleep(30)
    assert record['status'] == 'passed', 'hosted check observation deadline reached'
except BaseException as error:
    record.update(status='failed_or_incomplete', error=f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}')
    raise
finally:
    record['seconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
    with args.output.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps({'status': record['status'], 'receipt': str(args.output)}), flush=True)
